test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 24 Jan 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.**
solution: The correct answer is: **Share** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Share **means to divide, distribute, or partake in something with others. (किसी चीज़ को दूसरों के साथ बाँटना, बाँटना या उसमें भाग लेना) • **Example**: *The friends decided to share the cost of the meal equally.* • So, "**share**" is fitting in this context as it accurately expresses the collaborative and participatory nature of individuals within human societies who collectively contribute to and engage in common cultural practices and institutions. Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Oppose: **To be against or resist something. (किसी बात का विरोध या विरोध करना) • **Protect: **To safeguard or defend from harm or danger. (हानि या खतरे से रक्षा या बचाव करना) • **Divide: **To separate into parts or create a distinction between elements. (तत्वों को भागों में बाँटना या उनमें भेद पैदा करना) 1b5:Tb1f, The correct answer is: **Accomplish**
